planted.item: The break option was kept open and not waived in any negotiation.
The tenant agrees to reject the landlord's demand and ask them to repair the roof.
Helena Marsh will diarise the last date for serving notice and confirm it in writing next week.
Lena Ekdahl will collect the photographs and repair invoices by the fifteenth.
Helena Marsh will write to the landlord about the roof once Lena sends her the photographs.
It is unclear whether the insurer will cover the stock damaged by the leak.
